After 	the 	independence, 	Bangladesh 	Bureau 	of
Statistics (BBS) was established on August 26, 1974
by merging the then four organizations namely the
Bureau of Statistics under the Planning Commission,
the Bureau of Agriculture Statistics and the Agriculture
Census Commission under the Ministry of Agriculture,
and the Population Census Commission under the
Ministry of Home Affairs realizing the importance of
reliable and timely statistics for formulating evidence-
based planning and implementing and monitoring the
development activities. As the National Statistics Office
(NSO), BBS is entrusted with the responsibilities of
collecting, 	compiling, 	analysing, 	evaluating 	and
disseminating official statistics regularly on various
sectors, 	including 	socio-economic, 	demographic,
health, education, trade, national accounts, environment
and climate and so on. BBS has been functioning now
under the purview of the Statistics Act, 2013.

Like other countries, the Population and Housing
Census, due to its nature and robustness, is regarded as
Bangladesh’s the most significant and colossal statistical
undertaking. 	According 	to 	the 	“Principles 	and
Recommendations 	for 	Population 	and 	Housing
Censuses 	(Revision-3)” 	of 	the 	United 	Nations
Department of Economic and Social Affairs, Statistics
Division’s Guideline, A Population Census is the total
process of planning, collecting, compiling, evaluating,
analysing and disseminating demographic, economic
and 	social 	data 	at 	the 	smallest 	geographic level
pertaining, at a specified time, to all persons in a country
or in a well-delimited part of a country. The Population
and Housing Census consists mainly of two parts-
(১) জনশুিামর - মনমদ ভষ্ট্ 	সিয়য় একটি কদয়শ বসবাসরত প্র মতটি
 ব্য
মির 	আথ ভসািামজক 	ও 	জনমিমতক 	তথ্য 	-উপাত্ত	 ক্ষুদ্র	 	তি
কর্ৌয়গামেক 	�র (গ্র াি /িহল্লা) 	পর্ ভন্ত	 	সংগ্রহ ও প্র কাশ; এবং
(1) The Population Census, which provides socio-
economic and demographic information on every
person living in a country at a point in time, down
to the smallest geographical unit;
(২) গৃ হগণনা - মনমদ ভষ্ট্ 	সিয়য় একটি কদয়শর সকে আবামসক
ইউমনয়টর সংখ্যা 	, কাঠায়িাগত অবস্তা 	ও মবদ্যিান	 সু	 	য়র্াগ 	-সু মবধা

The main objective of the Population and Housing
Census is to provide accurate data on the population
living in the geographical territories of the country,
together with their dwellings. Furthermore, one of
its vital objectives is to provide data on vital
demographic characteristics of the population, and
the 	structure 	and 	facilities 	available 	in 	their
dwellings. The policymakers, planners, researchers,
media personnel, development partners, and other
stakeholders use the census data as the benchmark
for 	formulating 	and 	implementing 	local 	and
national 	plans 	and 	programs 	for 	overall
development.

Computer Assisted Personal Interviewing (CAPI)
পদ্ধ মতয়ত িাঠপর্ ভ ায় হয়ত তথ ু সংগ্রহ করা হয়।
After 	the 	independence 	of 	Bangladesh, 	BBS
conducted the first Population Census in 1974. The
second was conducted in 1981. Since then, censuses
have been conducted following a periodicity of ten
years. In connection with this, the fifth Population
and 	Housing 	Census 	was 	undertaken in 2011.
Following 	the 	ten 	year 	periodicity, 	the 	6 th
population and housing census was supposed to be
conducted in 2021, but it was not possible due to
the global pandemic, COVID-19. Therefore, the
census is conducted immediately after the COVID-
19 during 15-21 June 2022 all over the country at a
time. As per Section 6 (c) of the Statistics Act,
2013, previously conducted “Adamshumari” is now
termed “Janoshumari” in Bengali. It is the first
fully ICT-based census in the history of the country
in which data are collected using a electronic device
(Tablet) following the Computer Assisted Personal
Interviewing (CAPI) method.

statistical undertaking, a wide range of preparatory
activities 	is 	needed 	to 	conduct 	the 	census
successfully. Since the Population and Housing
Census 2022 is the first ICT-based census, every
step of its preparation is taken very carefully and
efficiently. The preparation begins in 2019 through
the approval of the ‘Population and Housing Census
2021 Project’. In order to conduct the census
perfectly, at first a ‘Time-bound Action Plan’ is
prepared and subsequently, all activities are carried
out accordingly. The major preparatory activities of
the census are as follows: -

The field-level census preparation begins through
the 	Zonal 	Operations. A total 	of 	three 	Zonal
Operations are carried out as part of the census
preparations. The census preparatory activities such
as forming EAs mapping, updating of geo-codes
corresponding 	to 	all 	administrative 	units,
identifying training centres, enlisting the restricted
areas, and preparing the list of VIPs residing in the
EAs are carried out under the Zonal Operations.
Additionally, 	enumerators 	and 	supervisors 	are
selected 	and 	appointed 	by 	the 	‘Selection
Committee’ with the help of field administrations.
In order to run the census perfectly to the extent
possible, including geo-code, all other information
is 	made 	entry 	into 	the 	Integrated 	Census
Management System (ICMS), installed at the BBS
headquarters, 	from 	the 	field 	during 	the 	Zonal
Operations. 	All 	maps, 	including 	EAs 	and
supervising areas with Geo-code are integrated
through ICMS under the Zonal Operations. 	As
zonal 	operations 	are 	conducted 	properly,
realistically and inclusively, it has been possible to
carry out census data collection activities easily,
smoothly and efficiently.

corresponding to administrative units. To develop

integration 	of 	Geographic 	Information 	System

delineate the EAs properly. Various kinds of maps
like 	Enumerator’s 	Maps, 	Supervisor’s 	Control
Maps, 	Zonal 	Officer’s 	Control 	Maps, 	Upazila
Census Coordinator’s (UCC) Control Maps, District
Census Coordinator’s (DCC) Control Maps and
Divisional Census Coordinator’s (DivCC) Control
Maps are developed digitally with the help of ICT
for the first time in order to ensure the inclusion of
each and every individual in census enumeration as
well as to have the high-quality data. Appropriate
legends and a sufficient number of landmarks are
added to the maps for the appropriate demarcation
of EA’s boundaries. In order to provide a clear
picture to the census personnel on the EAs, index
maps are put around the control maps. This process
predominantly contributes to reducing coverage
error of the census.

A 	web-based 	Integrated 	Census 	Management
System (ICMS) is developed to control and manage
the 	Population 	and 	Housing 	Census 	2022
efficiently. 	The 	ICMS 	is 	an 	ICT-based
infrastructure 	in 	which 	the 	name, 	designation,
address, mobile phone number and other particulars
of all census personnel, from enumerators to central
monitoring officers, are inserted. All managerial
activities of the census, including the techniques of
using digital maps and who is responsible for what
and so on, are carried out through ICMS.

In the Population and Housing Census 2022, the
data collected from households using the electronic
devices, tablets are directly transmitted through
mobile network to the Tier IV Data Centre located
at 	Bangabandhu 	Hi-Tech 	Park 	at 	Kaliakoir 	in
Gazipur 	belonging 	to 	Bangladesh 	Data 	Center
Company Limited (BDCCL). Later on, the data are
stored in the application server passing through the
Multilayer Firewall and the load balancer installed
in that data centre. To ensure the utmost security,
data 	are 	transmitted 	from 	the 	tablets 	to 	the
application 	servers 	through 	the 	cloud 	in 	fully
encrypted 	form. 	Subsequently, 	the 	data 	are
transferred by Oracle Exadata, installed in the Tier
IV Data Centre, from the cloud to the BDCCL Data
Centre in Dhaka through an optical fiber cable.
Afterwards, the data are passed through an optical
fiber cable from BDCCL to BBS Data Centre. It is
worth to mention that data are brought to BBS,
using the ICT infrastructure mentioned earlier, in
completely encrypted form, and later, make them
decrypted here in BBS. The decrypted data are
made possible to visualize in real-time on the giant
screen set out in the NOC at BBS Headquarters.

Census 2022 successfully.

As part of pre-census activities, a high-level meeting
chaired 	by 	the 	Cabinet 	Secretary, 	with 	the
participation of the thirty-six concerned secretaries or
equivalent officials of ministries/divisions/ agencies,
is 	held 	to 	coordinate 	census 	operation. 	In 	the
meeting, 	the 	pros 	and 	cons 	of 	the 	census 	are
reviewed comprehensively, and specific guidelines
and 	responsibilities 	are 	given 	to 	all 	Ministries/
Divisions/Agencies 	including 	SID. 	As 	a 	result,
performing preparatory census activities such as
census campaign, data collection etc., at the field
become 	easier 	and 	smoother. 	The 	Ministries/
Divisions/Agencies 	played 	vital 	roles 	in
accomplishing various activities of the census are:
Cabinet Division, Ministry of Public Administration,
Ministry 	of 	Home 	Affairs, 	Bangladesh 	Police,

The Questionnaire is the essential tool for data
collection of a census. As all the previous censuses
are conducted manually, their questionnaires are
paper-based. However, since the Population and
Housing Census 2022 are conducted following the
CAPI method, its questionnaire is designed keeping
online platform in consideration. In the case of
designing the census questionnaire, at first, a team in
the project is formed to develop its first draft keeping
the questionnaire of the last census 2011 and other
relevant issues in consideration. Later on, it is
thoroughly reviewed and analysed in a number of
consultation meetings organized at BBS level, and
made necessary changes. In order to make the
questionnaire 	more 	inclusive, 	a 	number 	of
consultation 	workshops 	are 	organized 	with 	the
participations 	of 	representatives 	from 	various
ministries/divisions/agencies, academics, researchers,
civil society members, media personnel, experts and
other stakeholders. Incorporating the comments and
suggestions received through the workshops, the
revised 	draft 	of 	the 	questionnaire 	is 	prepared.
Subsequently, it is further systematically reviewed
and 	analysed 	by the ‘Technical 	Support 	Team’
formed by the SID to accomplish technical activities
of the census, and followed by the ‘Professor’s
Forum’ formed with some renowned professors of
different universities. After that, the questionnaire is
pre-tested in the field to observe its performance. In
light of the experiences and findings gathered from
the pre-test, the final draft of the questionnaire is
prepared. Afterwards, its CAPI version is developed
to carry out data collection of the census and a field
test is conducted in every division to assess the
performance 	of 	the 	CAPI 	questionnaire. 	After
incorporating the findings of the test in the CAPI
version, again a pretest is conducted in 821 selected
EAs across the country. Based on the experiences
and findings from the pre-test, the CAPI version of
the questionnaire is finalized. Eventually, after a
series 	of 	the 	aforementioned 	processes, 	the

The questionnaire consists of two modules- the
Household Module and the Individual Module. In the
Household Module, there are 15 questions on various
characteristics 	of 	households 	namely 	types 	and
number 	of 	households 	and 	ownership 	status 	of
dwellings, source of drinking water, toilet facilities,
electricity facilities, sources of cooking fuel, foreign
remittance etc. In the Individual Module, there are 20
questions on different individual facts such as age,
sex, marital status, religion, disability, education,
working status, training, mobile phone and internet
use, 	banking 	inclusion, 	ethnic 	population 	etc.
Including all, there are 35 questions in the census
questionnaire.

Under the de facto method, people are enumerated in
the place where they stay at the census moment. To
perform 	the 	census 	counting 	smoothly 	in 	the
Population and Housing Census 2022, persons on
duty or journey at the census moment are enumerated
at their usual residences instead of being counted at
their workplaces or in vehicles, which is known as
the modified de-facto method.

To run the census perfectly the pilot census means to
examine 	all 	preparatory 	works 	of 	census 	just
immediately before the main census. It is also termed
as the dress-rehearsal of the main census. In order to
assess the entire final processes of the main census, a
pilot census was conducted from 27 April to 19 May
2022 in 28 selected sample EAs. Under the pilot, the
enumerators 	collect 	data 	from 	households 	using
tablets and transmit them to servers through online,
which have been ultimately transferred from the
cloud to the BBS data centre by using Oracle
Exadata 	installed 	in 	BDCCL, 	passing 	through
Optical Fiber Cable. In light of the experiences of the
pilot census, required modifications are made and the
overall census preparations are finalized.

To ensure inclusion of all in the census, the entire
country is fragmented into 3,81,053 Enumeration
Areas with a tiny portion for each. A total of 3,65,791
enumerators, usually one for each EA, are appointed
for data collection and a total of 63,550 supervisors
are appointed for supervising data collection activity
directly. These census workers are selected by the
‘Enumerator and Supervisor Selection Committee’
formed at Upazila, headed by the Upazila Nirbahi
Officer. This committee selects local youth literally
considering their ICT knowledge as well as their
skills on smart phone operations. A total of 3,779
zonal officers from 	BBS and other government
departments 	are 	engaged 	to 	supervise 	the
enumerators and supervisors’ activities at the field. It
is to be noted that, in order to conduct the first ever
ICT-based census smoothly, a total of 3,779 ICT
supervisors from the skilled local youths are also
engaged for providing ICT assistance to the zonal
officers. A total of 552 Upazila Census Coordinators
(UCC), 163 District Census Coordinators (DCC),
and 12 Divisional Census Coordinators (DivCC) are
engaged to coordinate and supervise census activities
at the field, including data collection. Approximately
4,37,000 personnel is directly engaged in various
activities of the census.
Cox’s Bazar district is divided into 2 census districts
for smooth implementation of census activities and
engaged 2 DCCs. 	Moreover 8 UCCs, 59 zonal

The midnight of 14 June 2022 (the zero moment of
15 June) is considered as ‘the census reference
point/time’, and the following week, 15-21 June
2022 as ‘the Census Week’. It is noted that, the
households located in each of the enumeration areas
are identified by the respective enumerators in the
previous two days (13 and 14 June 2022) of the
census enumeration. At first, the floating population
is counted on census night, from 12:00 o’clock at
night of 14 June to 6:00 am of 15 June 2022, across
the country which is considered as the ‘Census
Night’. Subsequently, the nationwide data collection
activities are carried out for 7 days from 15 to 21
June 2022. It is to be noted that, due to sudden flash
flood in the north-east region of the country, the data
collection period is extended for 7 days to 28 June
2022 	in 	four 	districts: 	Sylhet, 	Sunamganj,
Moulvibazar, 	and 	Netrokona, 	following 	the
international protocol of census.

Post Enumeration Check (PEC) Survey is conducted
immediately 	after 	every 	census 	in 	Bangladesh
following 	UN 	guidelines 	‘Principles 	and
Recommendation 	for 	Population 	and 	Housing
Census (Revision 3)’ to assess the coverage and
content error of the census data. The PEC survey is
carried 	out 	by 	an 	independent 	professional
organization, Bangladesh Institute of Development
Studies (BIDS). Data are collected from a total of
378 selected sample enumeration areas during 10-16
October 2022. The report of the PEC survey, which
is 	conducted 	independently, 	is 	published 	on 	06
February 2023. As per PEC survey findings, the Net
Coverage Error (NCE) is found to be 2.75%, which
is 	the 	lowest 	ever 	in 	the 	census 	history 	of
Bangladesh.

অ	অধ্যধ্য 	াায়য় ২২:: ধধাাররিিাা ও	ও সসংংজ্ঞজ্ঞ 	াা
Chapter 2: Concept and Definition
জনশুিামর ও গৃ হগণনা ২০২২ 	কার্ ভক্র	 	য়ি কর্ সব ধারণা ও সংজ্ঞ 	া
ব ু বহার করা হয়য়য়ে তা মনয়ম্ন 	বণ ভনা করা হয়ো-
In this chapter, the concepts and definitions used in
Population 	and 	Housing 	Census 	2022 	are
described, and these are as follows-
২২..১১ জ	জননশুশু িিাামমরর ওওগৃগৃ 	হহগগণণননাা 	2.1 Population and Housing Census
জামতসংয়ের 	গাইডোইন 	অনুর্ায়ী 	‘জনশুিামর 	হয়ো 	একটি সু
মনমদ ভষ্ট্ 	সিয়য় একটি কদশ বা মনধ ভামরত ভূ 	খয়ণ্ড 	বসবাসকারী
ব ু মিবয়গ ভর ক্ষুদ্র 	তি 	কর্ ৌয়গামেক 	সীিানাধীন 	জনমিমতক,
অথ ভকনমতক ও সািামজক তথ ু -উপাত্ত সংগ্রহ, সংকেন, মবয়িিণ,
পমরবী�ণ ও প্র কায়শর সু 	পমরকমল্পত 	সািণগ্রক	 প্র	 	মক্রয়া 	।’ এ শু িামরর মূ
ে ত দু ’টি প্র 	ধান 	অংশ রয়য়য়ে:
According to the United Nations Guidelines, ‘A
Population Census is the total process of planning,
collecting, 	compiling, 	evaluating, 	disseminating
and analysing demographic, economic and social
data at the smallest geographic level pertaining, at a
specified time, to all persons in a country or in a
well-delimited part of a country.’ There are two
main parts of the Population and Housing Census
as elaborated below:
((ক	ক)) জ	জননশুশু িিাামমরর:: জনশুিামরর 	িাধ্যয়ি 	মনমদ ভষ্ট্ 	সিয়য় একটি কদয়শর
সকে ব্য মি 	র জনমিমতক ও আথ ভসািামজক কিৌমেক তথ্য 	-উপাত্ত
 ক্ষুদ্র
তি 	কর্ৌয়গামেক 	�র (গ্রাি /িহল্লা) 	পর্ ভন্ত	 	সংগ্রহ 	করা হয়।
(a) Population Census: The Population Census
collects demographic and socio-economic basic
data of all persons of a country at a specified time
down 	to 	the 	smallest 	geographical 	level
(village/mahalla).
((খখ))গৃগৃ 	হহগগণণননাা:: গৃ হগণনা 	এিন একটি কার্ ভক্র	 	ি র্ 	ার িাধ্যয়ি 	মনমদ ভষ্ট্
সিয়য় একটি কদয়শর সকে আবামসক গৃ য়হর 	সংখ্যা 	, কাঠায়িাগত
মবন ুা স ও মবদ্যিান	 সু	 	য়র্াগ 	-সু মবধা 	সম্প 	মকভত কিৌমেক তথ্য 	-উপাত্ত
 ক্ষুদ্র
তি 	কর্ৌয়গামেক 	�র (গ্রা ি/িহল্লা) 	পর্ ভন্ত	 	সংগ্রহ 	করা হয়।
(b) Housing Census: The Housing Census collects
the basic data related to the number of all dwelling
houses, 	structural 	conditions, 	and 	facilities
available in the dwelling houses in a country at a
specified time down to the smallest geographical
level (village/mahalla).
২২..২২ গগণণননাা পপদ্ধদ্ধ ণণতত 	2.2 Enumeration Method
জনশুিামর ও গৃ হগণনা 	২০২২ এর তথ ু সংগ্রয়হ 	কিামডফাইড মড-
ফুায়ক্টা 	(Modified De-facto) পদ্ধমত অনুসরণ করা হ 	য়য়য়ে। এ
পদ্ধ মতয়ত 	খানার 	সদস্য 	গণয়ক শু 	িামর মুহূ 	য়তভ 	খানায় 	গণনার
পাশাপামশ কতযব্য 	রত ও ভ্র িণরত 	সদস ু য়কও তায়দর মনজ মনজ
খানায় গণনার্ভি করা হয় ।
The Population and Housing Census 2022 has been
conducted as per ‘modified defacto’ method. In this
method, 	alongside 	enumerating 	the 	household
members at their location at the census moment,
persons on duty and traveling at the census moment
are 	enumerated 	in 	their 	respective 	usual
households.
২২..৩৩শুশু 	িিাামমররমুমুহূহূ 	ততভভ 	2.3 Census Moment
 শু
িামর শুরু র শূ ন ু	 মুহূ	 	তভ-কক ‘শুিামর মুহূ 	তভ’ বো হয়। জনশুিামর ও গৃ
হগণনা ২০২২ এর 	‘শুিামর মুহূ 	তভ’ হয়ো ১৪ জু ন ২০২২ এর
মদবাগত রাত ১২:০০ (শূন ু মুহূ 	তভ ‘১৫ জু 	ন’)।
The moment at 12:00 a.m. on 14th June 2022
(00:00 hour of 15th June) is considered as the
'Census Moment' of the Population and Housing
Census 2022.
২২..৪৪শুশু 	িিাামমরর ররাাতত 	2.4 Census Night
 শু
িামর	 মুহূ	 	তভ হয়ত শুরু 	কয়র কর্ার 	৬:০০ টা পর্ ভন্ত	 	সিয় হয়ো
‘শু িামর 	রাত’। কস অনুর্ায়ী 	১৪ জু ন 	২০২২ মদবাগত রাত 	১২:০০
টা (শূন্য মুহূ 	তভ ১৫ জু ন) 	হবত কর্ার 	৬:০০ টা পর্ ভন্ত	 	সিয়য়ক
‘শুিামর 	রাত’ মহয়সয়ব গণ্য 	করা হয়।
The period from the census moment to 6:00 a.m. is
considered as ‘Census Night’. Hence, the period from
12:00 a.m. on 14th June 2022 (00:00 hour of 15th
June) to 6:00 a.m. is considered as ‘Census Night’.

২২..৫৫শুশু 	িিাামমররক	কাােে 	2.5 Census Period
‘শু িামর	 মুহূ	 	তভ’ হয়ত শুরু 	কয়র ২১ জু ন 	২০২২ পর্ ভন্ত	 	০৭ (সাত) মদন
‘শুমাণর কাল’ িা 	‘শু িামর 	সপ্তাহ ’ মহয়সয়ব গণ ু করা হয়।

Period as well as ‘Census Week’.
২২..৬৬ পপণণিি এএললাাক	কাা 	2.6 Rural Area
ণসটি কবপযাবরশন, জপৌরসভা, উপবজলা জহডবকায়াট যাস য (বপৌরসভা
ণহবসবি জ াণিত নয়) ও তৎসংণিষ্ট জমৌজা, কযান্টনবমন্ট, স্থ ানীয়
সরকার ণিভাগ কতৃ য ক তাণলকাভুক্ত 	জগ্র াথ জসন্টা র ও তৎসংণিষ্ট
জমৌজা িণহর্ভ য	 ত এলাকাবক পণি ণহবসবি গিয করা হয়।
The 	areas, 	outside 	the 	City 	Corporations,
Paurashavas, Upazila Headquarters (not declared as
Paurashava) 	including 	the 	entire 	areas of 	that
mauza, Cantonment areas, and the entire mauza of
the enlisted Growth Centres of Local Government
Divisions are treated as the Rural Areas.
২২..৭৭ শশহহরর এএললাাক	কাা 	2.7 Urban Area
পাঁ চ 	ধরবনর 	এলাকা র্ 	থাক্র 	বম 	ণসটি 	কবপযাবরশন, 	জপৌরসভা,
উপবজলা জহডবকায়াট যাস য (বপৌরসভা ণহবসবি জ াণিত নয়) ও
তৎসংণিষ্ট 	জমৌজা, কযান্টন বমন্ট, স্থ 	ানীয় সরকার ণিভাগ কতৃ য ক
তাণলকাভুক্ত জগ্রাথ জসন্টার ও তৎসংণিষ্ট জমৌজাবক শহর 	এোকা
ণহবসবি গিয করা হয়।
The five types of areas; the areas within the
jurisdictions of City Corporations, Paurashavas,
Upazila Headquarters (not declared as Paurashava)
including 	the 	entire 	areas 	of 	that 	mauza,
Cantonment areas, and the entire mauza of the
enlisted Growth Centres of 	Local 	Government
Division are treated as the Urban Areas.
২২..৮৮ খখাাননাা ওও খখাাননাারর সসদদস্যস্য 	2.8 Household and Household Members
এক বা একামধক ব্য মি	 র্	 	ারা 	এক পায়ক ও একয়ে খাবার গ্র হণ
এবং একসায়থ বসবাস কয়রন তায়দর সিিয়য় একটি খানা গঠিত
হয়। খানায় পমরবায়রর সদস্যয়দর 	পাশাপামশ অন্যান্য 	আত্মীয় 	বা
অনাত্মীয় 	সদস্যও 	থাকয়ত পায়র। তবি পমরবায়রর সদস্য 	হওয়া
সয়ত্ত্বও 	এক পায়ক ও একয়ে খাবার না কখয়ে বা অন্যত্র 	বসবাস
করয়ে, ণতণন খানার সদস্য 	মহয়সয়ব গণ্য 	হয়বন না।
A household consists of one or more persons who eat
from the same pot and live together. Along with
family members, any relative or unrelated person can
be household member. On the other hand, any family
member or relative who does not eat and live together
will not be considered as household member.
 শু
িামর রায়ত 	(১৪ জু ন ২০২২ মদবাগত রাত ১২ :০০ টা (শূন্য মুহূ 	তভ
১৫ জু ন) 	হবত কর্ার 	৬:০০ টা পর্ ভন্ত	 	) র্ 	ারা এক পায়ক কখয়য়য়েন
এবং 	একই 	োয়দর 	মনয়চ 	মকংবা 	বামড়য়ত 	বসবাস 	কয়রয়েন
তায়দরয়ক ঐ খানার সদস্য মহয়সয়ব 	অন্তর্ভ 	ভ	 	ি করা হয়। পমরবায়রর

((ক	ক)) ণণননজ	জস্বস্ব :: খানাপ্রধান বা 	খানার জকাবনা সদবস্যর ক্র য়কৃত িা

by a household which is purchased or inherited or
legally owned.
((খখ)) ভভাাড়ড়াা -- ণণক	কন্তুন্তু 	অ	অন্যন্যস্থস্থ 	াাববনন ণণননজ	জস্বস্ব 	িিাাসসগৃগৃ হহ আ	আববছছ:: আনুষ্ঠ া মনক বা
অনানুষ্ঠামনক চু মির িাধ্যয়ি র্ াড়ার মর্মত্তয়ত 	খানার সদস্যবদর
িসিাসকৃত 	বাসগৃহ মকন্তু অন্যে মনজস্ব িামেকানাধীন বাসগৃহ
রয়য়য়ে।
(b) 	Rented, 	but 	having 	own 	dwelling 	unit
elsewhere: A dwelling unit which is occupied by a

((গগ)) ভভাাড়ড়াা এএিিংং অ	অন্যন্য 	জজক	কাাথথাাওও ণণননজ	জস্বস্ব 	িিাাসসগৃগৃ হহ জজননইই:: আনুষ্ঠামনক বা
অনানুষ্ঠামনক চু মির িাধ্য 	য়ি র্ 	াড়ার মর্মত্তয়ত খানার সদস্যয়দর

(c) Rented and having no own dwelling unit

((েে)) মমববননাার্র্ 	াাড়ড়াা -- মমক	কন্তুন্তু 	অ	অন্যন্যস্থস্থ 	াাববনন মমননজ	জস্বস্ব 	ববাাসসগৃগৃ হহ আ	আয়য়েে:: খানাটির

((ঙঙ)) মমববননাার্র্ 	াাড়ড়াা এএববংং অ	অন্যন্য 	জজক	কাাথথাাওও মমননজ	জস্বস্ব 	ববাাসসগৃগৃ হহ জজননইই:: খানাটির

A person aged 5 years and above, having at least a
mobile phone with an active SIM card in his/her
collection and he/she used it at least once in the last
three months before the census, is considered as
having an own mobile phone for own use. In this
case, one can have his own phone or can have it as
a gift from someone or can receive it from his/her
employer; the SIM card can be registered in his/her
name or someone else’s name, and it can be
prepaid or post-paid. It is to be noted that, in case
of more than one user of a mobile phone, the
person who mostly use it, has been considered as
the person having a mobile phone for his/her own
use.

Formula:
Population Growth Rate (Exponential)
The annual population growth rate has been computed using the annual exponential formula: P n = p 0 × e rt
Where, 	p0 = Initial population
pn = Current population
r 	= Exponential rate of growth
t 	= time between two consecutive censuses
e 	= Constant ≈ 2.71828
Population Growth Rate (Exponential), r = 1/t*ln(Pn/P0)*100, where t = 11.25

Data on floor, wall and roof materials of the main dwelling structure are collected separately in this census. In
order to provide the data on dwelling structure by the category, pucca, semi pucca, kancha and jhupri, the
combination is provided in the table. Considering the dwelling structure of Chattogram Hill Tracts (Rangamati,
Khagrachhari and Bandarban) the combination of (5a=3, 5b=4, 5c=3) and (5a=4, 5b=4, 5c=3) is considered as
Kancha instead of Jhupri for other district. According to the census questionnaire, floor, wall and roof materials
of main dwelling structure are collected by following mentioned options:
5a. Floor materials of main dwelling structure
1. Cement/concrete/brick/terracotta
2. Tiles/mosaic
3. Wood/bamboo/mat/palm tree/betel nut trunk
4. Soil/sand/mud
5. Other materials
5b. Wall materials of main dwelling structure
1. Cement/concrete/brick/terracotta
2. Ceramic Tiles
3. Metal sheet/CI sheet/Corrugated Iron sheet
4. Wood/bamboo/mat/palm tree/betel nut trunk
5. Straw/chhan/golpata/palm leaf/bichali/polythene
6. Soil/mud
7. Other Materials
8. No wall
5c. Roof materials of main dwelling structure
1. Cement/concrete/tile
2. Metal Sheet/CI Sheet/Corrugated Iron Sheet
3. Wood/bamboo/mat/straw/chhan/bichali/golpata/palm leaf/polythene
4. Hand-made tiles/tile
5. Other Materials
6. No roof
